name: Samoa

fees.name: Visitor's Permit (issued free on arrival)
fees.notes: Multiple secondary sources (Samoa Pocket Guide, thingstodoinsamoa.com, AE-SQUARE) consistently state Samoa issues a free 90-day Visitor's Permit on arrival for eligible nationalities, with no visa fee charged. Could not retrieve a readable official fee schedule from mpmc.gov.ws (Immigration Division, 403 on fetch) or a Contentful/PDF fee sheet to independently confirm the exact figure of 0, so official flag is left false pending direct confirmation.

fees.name: Visitor Permit extension
fees.applies: all nationalities already in Samoa on a Visitor's Permit
fees.notes: Reported extension fee of ST$100 (Samoan Tala) for extending a visitor permit beyond the initial free 90-day stay. Sourced from secondary travel-guide sites citing the Ministry of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (MPMC) Immigration Division; the MPMC official page (mpmc.gov.ws/divisions/immigration/) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch so this could not be verified against the primary source in this session.

free_visa_notes: Samoa issues a free 90-day Visitor's Permit on arrival to most eligible nationalities (no visa application fee). No evidence found of a paid e-visa, eTA, or VFS-outsourced visa process for Samoa. Long-stay/work permits and visitor-permit extensions (reported ST$100) are outside the free entry-permit scope. Government primary source (mpmc.gov.ws Immigration Division) could not be fetched directly (403) to confirm exact figures, hence confidence is medium rather than high.
